name: c-assistant
description: Country-neutral regional assistant Core with a China Country Pack.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @c-assistant/core build && concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @c-assistant/server dev" "pnpm --filter @c-assistant/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @c-assistant/core build && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/server build && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @c-assistant/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/web typecheck
